title: Scaling dbt on Amazon Redshift: KOHO cut transformation runtime 70% without rewriting a single model
description:
How KOHO built KoDa, a Claude-powered self-serve analytics tool, on years of dbt governance. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Célia Bru, senior director of data, and Gabriel Gambacorta, technical product manager at KOHO, argue that the hard part of self-serve analytics was never the AI: years of data-team culture work and dbt governance made KoDa possible. KoDa is deliberately scoped to analytics use cases, certified dbt mart models only, no PII, read-only, with every answer traced to the same components. The real engineering effort went into evaluation, with an eval council and a library of about 375 real analyst questions to catch regressions.

In this session you'll learn:
• Why governance and culture come before an AI analytics tool
• How to scope an AI analytics agent safely
• How an eval council and question library catch regressions

Speakers: Célia Bru and Gabriel Gambacorta, KOHO

Read more: Scaling AI is easy. Trusting it is hard. https://www.getdbt.com/blog/scaling-ai-is-easy-trusting-it-is-hard
